geometry: Three white piano-key silhouettes on a transparent 14 by 14 canvas. The keys occupy rows 1–12, with narrow upper stems through row 7 and wider lower portions from row 8. All surrounding space and gaps are transparent.
limitations: The source consists of axis-aligned, opaque white shapes and fully transparent pixels; the vector follows those native edges. Native and 8x renderings were inspected against dark and white backgrounds.
